title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish made with eggs, cheese, crispy bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Fry the bacon until crispy, then set aside.
Whisk eggs and grated Parmesan cheese together in a bowl.
Drain the pasta and add it to the pan with bacon.
Remove from heat and quickly mix in the egg and cheese mixture.
Season with black pepper and serve hot.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender grilled chicken cooked in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through.
Sauté onions, garlic, and ginger in a pan.
Add tomato puree and spices, then simmer.
Stir in cream and grilled chicken.
Cook for a few minutes and serve with rice or naan.
